name: Nāsadīya Sūkta (Ṛgveda 10.129)

surviving_manuscript_date.note: The Vedic corpus was transmitted orally for centuries; no early physical manuscript date is asserted here.

estimated_composition.method: Broad range anchored to standard Ṛgvedic chronology and the relative lateness of Mandala 10; not a point date for hymn 10.129.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Questions cosmic origins rather than dating them.

estimated_oral_origin.method: Pre-compositional oral history cannot be dated from the sources used here.

dating.dating_summary: A later-layer Ṛgvedic hymn within a corpus composed and collected over centuries; exact hymn dating is not recoverable.

notes: Its concluding uncertainty is preserved in claim text rather than converted into an influence claim.
